### God, I Don't Understand
Author: Glynnis Whitwer
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/god-i-don-t-understand-encouragement-for-today-jan-4-2013.html
Passage: Proverbs 3:5-6
Points:
- Focusing excessively on why painful circumstances occur can undermine our faith.
- Human understanding is frail, emotional, and incomplete, whereas God possesses perfect knowledge.
- Finding lasting peace does not require having answers, but knowing the trustworthy God.
- When situations seem senseless, we are invited to surrender our limited understanding and lean on Him.

### Duh?
Author: Wendy Pope
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-nov-26-2007-11559845.html
Passage: Proverbs 3:5-6
Points:
- People often disregard clear divine directions because they assume their personal way is better.
- Impatience drives us to lean on our own logic rather than waiting on God.
- Pursuing our own shortcuts inevitably leads into closed roads and spiritual detours.
- Learning wholehearted trust comes through daily prayer and choosing obedience when boundaries appear.
